findings.issue: Definite common noun (article + H4720) is left as the untranslated lemma mikdash; common nouns stay Spanish.
santidad takes the common noun as abstract holiness; the lemma also licenses a holy thing, and the morphology does not decide.
Qal infinitive construct of fill is rendered as reflexive llenarse; the infinitive is not marked middle.

notes: The vav counts, plural sangres, 3fs qal verbs, and the 3fs suffix on purificación match; singular יוֹם with the cardinal thirty is Spanish number agreement.
